title: Live Props for Real-Time Updates in Inertia.js v3.11
content:
Inertia.js v3.11 adds live props, which reload a page prop when a broadcast event arrives, with Laravel Echo, Reverb, Pusher, and Action Cable transports.

The post Live Props for Real-Time Updates in Inertia.js v3.11 appeared first on Laravel News.
